en:
Well, then. Shall I tell the first story?
My name is Akemi Iwashita.
...A pleasure.
I'll come straight to the point: there are no "seven wonders" at this school.
Because seven would never be enough.
You see, this entire school is cursed.{p}

Heh heh heh... Do you want to know?
An evil spirit lives in this school.
And that evil spirit is always bringing misfortune with it.
That's why this school is full of strange happenings.
The story I'm going to tell is about a prank that evil spirit played.
Just a trifling little prank by an evil spirit.{p}

Do you know a boy named Kota Uchiyama, who used to be in Class 1-E?
You're a first-year, aren't you?
Class E, if I'm not mistaken?{p}You know Kota Uchiyama, don't you?
I know him
I don't know him

I see.
Then that makes this quicker.{p}

Uchiyama was bullied.
He was a quiet boy with a good nature, but he was too kind.
He couldn't say no when he was ordered around, so he did whatever the bullies told him.
Without so much as a frown, always smiling, he faithfully did everything he was ordered to do.
And that got on the bullies' nerves.
But I suppose they would have bullied him even if he had defied them.
Bullies are selfish creatures.
Defy them, and they beat you because they don't like it.
Obey them, and they kick you around because it's no fun.
Either way, they bully you.
They're selfish, those people.
Even so, at first it was half in jest.
It was hardly bullying, just teasing, and to anyone watching, it really did look like horseplay.
But it didn't take long to escalate.
In less than a month, they were making him shoplift and telling him to bring them money.
And if he dared to refuse, they punched and kicked him as hard as they could.{p}You knew Uchiyama was being treated that cruelly, didn't you?
I knew
I didn't know

So you knew.
Of course you did. You're in the same class, after all.
There's no way you couldn't have known.
...I'm sorry. Let's go on with the story.
Uchiyama wanted everyone to help him.
Coming to school was agony for him.
But he couldn't let his mother worry about him.
So he kept coming to school without a word.
Believing that someday his classmates would help him.{p}Did you help Uchiyama?
I helped him
I didn't help him

I suspect you're the only one who thinks so.
You helped him? How, exactly, did you help him?
If you had really helped him, it would never have come to that.
You didn't help him at all.{p}
You abandoned Uchiyama, didn't you?{p}

...Since no one would help him, Uchiyama thought about a great many things.
About why he was the one being bullied.
And then he understood.
Why he was the one being bullied.
Why do you think it was?
That's right. Because everyone was possessed by the evil spirit.
The evil spirit that lives in this school had possessed every one of them.
The bullies, of course, but also the cold-hearted classmates and teachers who saw him being bullied and pretended not to.
Uchiyama, the only one the evil spirit hadn't possessed, was the one being made to suffer.
Uchiyama told everyone.
He told them they were all possessed by an evil spirit.
But they only laughed at him.
They looked at him as if he were some kind of freak, and no one would talk to him anymore.
Terrible, isn't it?{p}

...Oh, what's the matter?
You don't look well.
Are you feeling sick?{p}Or are you feeling guilty about what you did?
It's not my fault
I was to blame too

That's right, it's not your fault.
Then there's no need to be so jumpy, is there?
You're not the one to blame.
The bullies are the ones to blame, aren't they?
Or are you saying Uchiyama is responsible for being bullied?
...It was after that.
Uchiyama started seeing strange things.{p}

Everyone at school looked like an evil spirit to him.
Do you know what an evil spirit's face looks like?
Oh, it's a terrifying face.
The ears are pointed, the eyes slant upward, and the mouth is split hideously wide, with fangs peeking out from inside.
To put it more concretely, let me see... your face right now looks like an evil spirit's to me.
Heh heh heh... I'm joking. Only joking.
In the end, with no one ever helping him, Uchiyama stopped coming to school.
A school attended by nothing but evil spirits... I'd be too frightened to go to a place like that myself.
And so he quit school.
Uchiyama dropped out about three weeks ago, didn't he?
That was the reason.
Did the bullying drive Uchiyama mad?
Or was everyone truly possessed by evil spirits?
Perhaps it doesn't matter either way.
Uchiyama may have quit, but the bullies are still coming to school as if nothing happened.{p}

What? What do I think?
Well, I believe everyone was possessed by evil spirits.
Otherwise, it would be strange for everyone to keep coming to school so calmly after what happened.
And that includes all of you who were his classmates.{p}

Oh?
Are you trembling?
There's no need to tremble.
Uchiyama's story goes on.
Do you know what became of Uchiyama after he quit school?
Of course you don't.
You hardly had anything to do with him. Why would you care what happened to a classmate who dropped out?{p}

Uchiyama went on seeing the evil spirit even after that.
The evil spirit must have been terribly fond of Uchiyama.
Maybe that's why it made the bullies torment him.
Once he'd quit school and had nothing to do with anyone anymore, the evil spirit came after him.
It followed him all the way to his house and wouldn't leave Uchiyama's side.
So what do you think Uchiyama did?
He fought it. He fought the evil spirit.

Even so, the evil spirit wouldn't leave Uchiyama.
And at last, it possessed him. It possessed Uchiyama himself.
Possessed by the evil spirit, he fought desperately.
And he slit his own throat with a box cutter.

...I hear it happened three days ago.
They say when his mother went into his room, the whole room was red with blood.
But that was how Uchiyama was finally freed from the evil spirit.
And that is the end of Uchiyama's story.
You didn't know, did you?
...By the way, do you know why I told you this story?
What's wrong?
You've gone white as a sheet.
What are you afraid of?
There's nothing to be afraid of.
Nothing at all to be afraid of.
All you have to do now is take responsibility.
It's no more than your duty, after all.{p}

I told you this story so that you would know how much Uchiyama suffered, how much it hurt.
I know, you see.
I know you were the one bullying Uchiyama.
I know you were the leader of the group that bullied him.{p}You were, weren't you!
I didn't bully him
Yes, I bullied him

"I never bullied him! You've got it all wrong!"
I shouted, beside myself.
Somehow, Iwashita's face looked terrifying.
As if she were possessed by something...
I didn't understand why Iwashita was telling me about Uchiyama.
It was true that there had been a bullied boy named Uchiyama in my class.
And he had dropped out about three weeks ago.
But I had never bullied him.{p}

"Don't you lie to me! You bullied him!
You killed Kota!"
Before I knew it, she was gripping a box cutter in her hand.

With a click-click-click like a chirping insect, the box cutter's blade slid out as far as it would go.
She showed her bright red tongue, pressed the blade against it, and licked it from bottom to tip in one long slurp.
On her red tongue, a thread of even redder blood welled up.
She was laughing.
My legs had frozen. I couldn't move.
She had it wrong.
She had it wrong. She thought I was the ringleader who had bullied Uchiyama.
"It wasn't me! I really had nothing to do with it!"
I screamed.
But my screams didn't seem to reach her ears.{p}

"It was you! You killed Kota!"
She's going to kill me!
She raised the box cutter high over her head.
And then...
My consciousness slipped away.{p}

Five faces came into view, peering down at me with concern.
It seemed I had been saved.
"What... happened to me...? Where's Iwashita...?"
I couldn't see Iwashita's face.
I slowly lifted my still-reeling head and looked around.{p}

"We managed to hold her down.
She was really worked up.
If we'd been any slower to stop her, you'd definitely have fallen prey to that box cutter."

Little by little, the feeling of being alive spread through my whole body.
My heart was still pounding.
"Once she calmed down, she suddenly burst into tears.
And she told us everything.
Apparently, this Kota Uchiyama was her younger brother.
It seems her parents divorced a few years ago, and each of them took one of the children.
That's why they had different surnames.
They apparently kept it a secret from everyone at school, but it sounds like the two of them were very close.
She hated the ones who bullied him, of course, but also every single classmate who stood by and let her brother die.
It was rotten luck for you, but I can't say I don't understand how she feels."
I listened in a daze.
Put that way, maybe I really did bear some of the responsibility too.
"So, where's Iwashita?"

"Oh, she suddenly staggered out of the room.
Well, of course she couldn't bear to stay here."
Another one of them picked up from there.
"I don't mean to echo her story, but maybe there really is an evil spirit in this school.
I mean, her face when she went for you... that was the face of someone possessed by an evil spirit, no doubt about it."
Everyone nodded at that.
I thought so too.
That face really hadn't looked human.
As everyone sat in silence, one of them abruptly murmured.{p}"So what now? After all this, do you still want to go on with the seven wonders?"
Keep going
Stop here

"No, let's stop here. I'm sorry, after you all went to the trouble of coming.
Could we save the rest for another time?"
I didn't have the courage to go on with these stories any longer.
I never wanted to go through anything like that again.
I was sorry, but tomorrow I would talk to the club president and get someone else to take over this job.
That creepy feeling I'd had at the very start might have been about Iwashita.
There really was an evil spirit lurking in this school.
"Yeah. After something like this, none of us feels like going on."
It seemed everyone felt the same way.
Of course they did.
I doubted they would ever gather again.
But that was none of my concern anymore.{p}

I left the school as if I were running away.
I couldn't really remember how I got home.
But the fact that I was here at home proved I had made it back safely.
That night, in bed, I thought it over.
Should I go to school tomorrow?
At this rate, I was going to end up refusing to go to school too.
Too frightened to turn the light off, I just couldn't fall asleep.
Iwashita's face in that moment was burned into my mind. I couldn't shake it.
That's it, I won't go.
I won't go to school tomorrow.
I won't......{p}

Even so, at some point I fell asleep.
...Suddenly, I woke up, struggling to breathe.

My chest was heavy.
It felt as if something were pressing down hard on my chest.
Something was there.
Someone was in my room.
But I was too scared to open my eyes.
Warm, clammy breath blew across my face.
Who is it?
Who's sitting on my chest?
My body wouldn't move.
I was paralyzed!
Like a snake's tongue licking my face, the warm breath washed over every inch of it.
The breath stopped moving at my ear.
It was murmuring something.
A mumbling voice I could barely make out crept into my ear.
The voice grew steadily louder.
"I'll kill you... I'll kill you..."
Each time that warm breath came out, the words of the curse stroked my ear.
"Aaagh!"
In sheer terror, my eyes flew open.{p}

There she was.
Iwashita, a box cutter in her hand, was sitting on my chest.
"An evil spirit possessed me too, you see.
So I fought it. And thanks to that, I've been freed from the evil spirit too. Now it's your turn!"
Her throat was split wide open.
The blood dripping from it, drop by drop, wet my face.
With an ugly click-click-click, the box cutter's blade glittered.

I couldn't escape.
Iwashita's hand rose high.
Her face was the evil spirit itself.
The evil spirit must have taken a liking to me too.
That was my last conscious thought.
Watching the blood spray up from my own throat, I lost consciousness for the last time...{p}

...You don't know him?
And you're in the same class. How cold of you.
Well, I suppose you weren't especially close... is that it?
Uchiyama was the kind of person who couldn't say no, whatever happened, wasn't he?
So he got... bullied a little, that sort of thing, didn't he?{p}
They made him shoplift, told him to bring them money... and if he dared to refuse, they punched and kicked him as hard as they could.{p}You knew that much, didn't you?

...What are you saying?
Are you telling me you never even saw the bruises and cuts on Uchiyama's face?
...I'm sorry. For raising my voice...
Uchiyama couldn't let his mother worry, so even when he was bruised and cut, he kept coming to school without a word.
I think what he really wanted was for everyone to help him.
But... was there anyone who helped him?
What about you?{p}Did you help Uchiyama...?

Liar!
You said you didn't know Uchiyama was being shaken down, so how can you say you helped him?
...What's that look on your face?{p}Are you afraid of me?
I'm afraid
I'm not afraid

I know.
You knew all along that Uchiyama was being bullied.{p}But you didn't help him, did you?

...That's right, isn't it?
I thought you were that kind of person.
You care about yourself most of all, don't you?
It's fine. I understand.
If you weren't careful, they might have turned on you instead.
......Everyone's the same.
You can't imagine the pain of someone who's bullied, can you?
As long as every day is fun, that's all that matters to you, isn't it?{p}

Well? That's how it is, isn't it?
It is, isn't it?
Why don't you just admit it?
...My, what a face you're making.
I'm not blaming only you, you know.
I'm angry at everyone who didn't help Uchiyama.
You understand, don't you?{p}You, of all people, would understand, wouldn't you?

I see...
So you think you were wrong?
...That's easy enough to say.
But saying it doesn't mean all is forgiven.
...Did you know this?
There was someone Uchiyama was in love with.
...Do you want to hear?{p}Do you want me to tell you who it was?
Yes, tell me
No, I don't want to know

...You want to know?
Then I'll tell you.
It was Otaki.
Otaki, from Uchiyama's class.
Uchiyama was in agony.
Because everyone in his class had an evil spirit on them.
Which naturally meant Otaki had an evil spirit on her too.
Uchiyama thought it over.
Should he love her even with an evil spirit on her?
Or must he not love her...?{p}So what do you think Uchiyama did?
He loved her
He didn't love her

That's right. Uchiyama decided he must not love her.
He realized that it wasn't love that could save her.{p}

After that, Uchiyama started going to the library.
And to secondhand bookstores, too.
Do you know why?
...That's right. To save her.
He believed there had to be some way to drive the evil spirit out of her body.
Even though he'd decided not to love her, he worked so hard for her sake.
Even if he didn't mean to, I think he still loved her after all.
So he read all kinds of books.
And at last, he found it.
A way to save someone possessed by an evil spirit.{p}

...From the very next day, Uchiyama started following Otaki around.
Uchiyama was such an earnest person that he followed her around relentlessly, to the point of obsession.
Naturally, it gave her the creeps.
You can't blame her.
She had no idea what he was after, or anything else.
She was so frightened that one of the boys couldn't stand by and watch anymore.
He announced he was going to teach Uchiyama a lesson.
Maybe he had a crush on Otaki himself.
Well, even if he didn't, there's always that type who butts in just to look cool, isn't there?{p}

One evening, that boy and a few others surrounded Uchiyama.
And shoving him around, they said something like this:
"Stay the hell away from Otaki."
...As they beat him, Uchiyama realized that they had to be the evil spirits possessing Otaki.{p}What do you think went through Uchiyama's mind then?
Lunge at the boy
Just apologize meekly for now

That's right. Uchiyama let out a yell and lunged at the boy.
Caught off guard, the boy was knocked flat.
Uchiyama straddled him and flailed his arms wildly.
But he was gentle by nature and had never been in a fight.
In no time at all, he was shoved off and knocked down.

The furious boys beat Uchiyama again and again as he lay curled up on the ground.
When they had finally had their fill, they left, taking Otaki with them.{p}

Left behind, Uchiyama dragged his aching body home, barely making it.
...And after that, he never came to school again.
The book where Uchiyama found the way to drive out evil spirits apparently also described the opposite: a way to set an evil spirit on someone.
...That's right. Uchiyama decided to set an evil spirit on the boys who had bullied him.
...By the way, {a}, weren't you one of the boys who beat Uchiyama that day?
You seem to have a strong sense of justice.
Weren't you a little too eager to protect Otaki?
If so, you're in serious trouble.
Uchiyama is truly trying to curse you.
If you don't turn the curse back on him, you're in danger.{p}If you like, shall I teach you how?
Please teach me
I don't need it

......Just as I thought.
So you were one of the ones who bullied Uchiyama too.
Otherwise you'd have no need to ask how to turn a curse back.
How could you keep such an innocent face all this time?
As if someone as kind as Uchiyama would ever put a curse on anyone.
I'm Uchiyama's childhood friend, you know.
He's a little timid, but he's a very good person.
I will never forgive anyone who hurts someone like that.{p}

It was a terrible shock to Uchiyama, you see.
Misunderstood by the one he loved, and on top of that, beaten up by you people.
If he went to school the next day, he'd surely be bullied again.
Thinking that, Uchiyama tried to kill himself.
Fortunately, he survived, but he still hasn't regained consciousness, and he's in the hospital.
...What's that face?
Have you finally realized how serious your actions were?
It's too late.
No matter how much you apologize, Uchiyama won't wake up.{p}

...No, there is just one way.
I saw Uchiyama's book.
It described a way to bring back someone in his condition.
You cut the left little finger of someone he loves, or, the other way around, someone he hates.
Then you let the blood drip onto his heart while he sleeps.
The one Uchiyama loved was Otaki.
And the one he hated was......you, {a}, wasn't it?
Whose finger would work better, I wonder?
What do you think, {a}?{p}

......Oh, don't make that face.
Even I wouldn't swallow whole what's written in a book like that.
Really, as if a few drops of blood would do any good.
If it were every last drop of blood in the whole body, then I might believe it...
Oh my, now that I look, what lovely hands you have, {a}... Heh heh heh.
Oh dear, I've wandered off the subject.
Well then, shall we hand over to the next person?{p}

"No, let's continue.
Somehow I feel like we have to..."{p}

Yes, Uchiyama loved her even so.
That's why it was so painful.
So he thought about it.
Whether everyone in his class really did have evil spirits on them.
Uchiyama thought for a long time...
And then he reached a conclusion.
What would you think, in his place?{p}What conclusion would you reach?
There are no evil spirits
Everyone but her has an evil spirit
She has an evil spirit too

Yes.
Uchiyama thought so too.
That there are no evil spirits.
And he decided to change.
He decided to change who he was and live a different kind of life, day after day.
And before long, he stopped seeing evil spirits at all.
Uchiyama was sure his conclusion had been right.
Well?
Didn't you think Uchiyama had changed?{p}

Having said that much, Iwashita let out a long white breath.
White breath?
It wasn't even winter.
...I had seen it somewhere before.
White breath like this.
Uchiyama.
Uchiyama used to breathe out white breath.
Back when he was being bullied.
In the classroom, in the warm days of spring.
Uchiyama's seat was by the window.
I had thought it was only dust stirred up by his breathing, lit by the light from the window so that it looked like white breath.
But this breath of hers...?
"I believe there are evil spirits,"
Iwashita murmured.
Breathing out white breath.
"They say the evil spirits won't lay a hand on Uchiyama anymore.
Because Uchiyama has grown strong.
Inside, I mean.
They say that sort of thing is boring.
Evil spirits, you know, prey on people who scare easily.
I scare easily too, so I'm worried."
She kept breathing out white breath.
"What about you?
How about you?
Do you scare easily...?"
She huffed her breath onto her hand, then smeared that hand across my cheek.
"What's wrong?"
she said, staring at me.
Are you scared?
That's fine.
Be more scared.
Evil spirits are always after people who scare easily.
They say that when an evil spirit is close by, white breath comes out of the mouths of people with a sixth sense.
Well, does my breath look white...?
It's no use trying to run.
You have to hear the next story.
Heh heh heh...
...Now, whose turn is next?{p}

Nothing's ever that convenient.
Think it through properly.
Uchiyama thought and thought before he reached his conclusion.{p}Now, what conclusion will you reach?
There are no evil spirits
She has an evil spirit too

Yes.
This is what Uchiyama thought:
however much he loved her, he couldn't bend the facts.
But Uchiyama couldn't just abandon her.
So he decided:
he would do anything for the girl he loved.
And so Uchiyama wrote her letters.
Every day, day after day, he wrote her a letter.
'An evil spirit has possessed you.
But I will protect you.
I am the one who loves you.' Like that.
Uchiyama sent the letters without signing his name.
But you can see it, can't you?
Anyone who read something like that would know who wrote it.
She got scared and talked it over with everyone.{p}

...And what do you think happened then?
The bullies surrounded Uchiyama and laid into him, telling him to stop harassing her.
Where was it, now?
Ah, yes.
On the stairs in the old school building.
Nobody ever goes there.{p}

"Is that true?"
I leaned forward.
This had to be about today.
At lunch break.
The bullies, who had been ignoring Uchiyama for a while, had called him out.
Afterward, Uchiyama had come to the next class, but the bullies hadn't come back...
Everyone assumed they were skipping class.
But...
What was this dread churning in my chest?{p}

"Do you want to know?"
Iwashita said.
"Do you want to know what happened to the people who bullied Uchiyama?"
...

Was it only my imagination that I thought I heard someone crying?
"The evil spirit was real,"
Iwashita said.
"The evil spirit really did exist.
Maybe it got excited, watching the bullies lay into Uchiyama for the first time in so long.{p}

It appeared, right there.
On the stairs of the old school building.
The bullies were terrified out of their wits.
Shrieking at the top of their lungs.
Uchiyama knew evil spirits existed, so he didn't panic the way the bullies did.
But that was when the tragedy happened.
One of the startled bullies went down the stairs...{p}

It seems the kid landed badly.
By the time Uchiyama ran down, the kid had already stopped breathing.
Uchiyama didn't know what to do.
But he couldn't tell anyone.
Well, could he?
Nobody would believe Uchiyama's story.
They all deny that evil spirits exist.
So Uchiyama went back to class alone, without a word.
One of the bullies should still be lying on those stairs right now.
If nobody has found the body, that is.
...What happened to the rest of the bullies, you ask?
Who knows...{p}

Maybe the evil spirit carried them off?
Evil spirits are fond of slightly timid people like Uchiyama, but they simply adore twisted people like the bullies too...
Hm?
How do I know this story, you ask?
Heh heh heh, that's because..."{p}

I heard crying.
Someone was crying.
Iwashita stood up.
The blue light left Iwashita's body and rose upward.{p}

The crying grew even louder.
As if begging for help...{p}

The crying stopped, and as the blue light drifted out the window, Iwashita collapsed onto the floor.
When we all rushed over in alarm, she said something strange.{p}

"I'm sorry, I felt dizzy...
I'm telling the first story, aren't I?
Let me see, what should I talk about?"
We all looked at one another.
She'd been talking all this time. What was she saying?
And that blue light?
That crying?{p}

"An evil spirit?"
someone said.
"No way, the evil spirit from that story jumped into h..."
I see.
That would make sense.
Was that blue light the evil spirit's true form?
Then what about that crying?
"In that story, the rest of the bullies got carried off by the evil spirit..."
Was that crying the bullies'...?
As a frozen chill filled the air, someone said,
"So there really is something in this school.
But how much of that story was true...
Earlier I was walking around looking for material, and I went to the old school building too, but there wasn't anybody lying there.
Either the evil spirit took the guy away, body and all, or the whole story was made up by the evil spirit...
Well, anyway, let's move on to the next story.
Who's up next?"{p}

"Thinking you have to become a ghost to be friends with me and our classmates...
That's no way to think."
I looked Uchiyama straight in the eye as I said it.
He must have been serious, in his own way.
In that case, I had to think it over carefully and give him a serious answer too.
"Right now, I can't be your friend, Uchiyama.
You say you want to be friends with everyone, Uchiyama, but as long as you still believe our classmates have evil spirits on them, I don't think anyone will ever be able to be your true friend.
But I don't want you to get me wrong.
You came to school every day, Uchiyama, even when it was hard, didn't you?
You tried not to make your mother worry, didn't you?
I think I could have been friends with that Uchiyama.
And yet I pretended not to see the bullying...
I wish we had talked about all sorts of things sooner.
I'm really sorry...!"
I kept looking into Uchiyama's eyes.
Uchiyama didn't look away either.
He had big, round eyes.
Uchiyama was crying.
Still crying, he quietly faded away.{p}

Pressing my temples, I pictured the afterimage of Uchiyama, his eyes wide open.
"{a}..."
someone said.
"Was that story true?
Was somebody named Uchiyama really here...?"
I sat down in my seat without a word.
The seat was damp and clammy.{p}

Uchiyama's tears, perhaps?
Iwashita said in a small voice,
"I believe what Uchiyama said.
The evil spirits were real.
To the evil spirits, it was just a harmless little prank.
But to Uchiyama...
That's why we have to be careful.
There really are evil spirits in this school..."
We looked at one another.
Everyone looked uneasy.
Iwashita said,
"That's the end of my story.
...Whose turn is next?"{p}

Why don't you want to hear it?
You'd better hear it.
No, you have to hear it.{p}The one Uchiyama liked was... you.
Hear the rest
Shut her up

Do you want me to tell you what that means?
Then you should ask him yourself.
Uchiyama.
Uchiyama, you're there, aren't you?{p}

...
There was a knock.
The air grew tense.

Another knock.
Who was it?

Yet another knock.
Rougher this time.

"{a}, go open it,"
someone said.
Uchiyama, on the other side of the door?
Wasn't the timing a little too perfect?
